_comment: Editorial half of the skill-version policy the MCP server broadcasts. latest_version is NOT set here; the release workflow derives it from the released tag. Edit this file in the same PR that bumps the SKILL.md version. recommended_min_version is optional and defaults to the released version (recommend latest). deprecated_below_version is the deliberate floor: versions below it are announced as deprecated. latest_updates is a newest-first, human-readable summary shown to agents. Version values use skill semver including pre-release identifiers.
latest_updates: 1.0.0-beta.6: user-data translation (open-ended responses, comments) and audio transcription via OpenAI, with a single API key that is never exposed, user-selectable models (cheapest as default), automatic chunking of long audio, a cost-confirmation gate, PII warnings, and caching; plus a bundled dataset validator (assets/dataset-validation/validate_dataset.py) that checks a dataset definition against the server's create/edit rules and cross-checks field maps against referenced forms, with a validate-and-self-correct workflow for dataset authoring.

1.0.0-beta.5: skill self-checks its version against the MCP server's published policy and prompts users to update when out of date; dataset reference standardizes on SERVER datasets with corrected dataLink element order; field plug-in test-harness fix.

1.0.0-beta.4: substantially expanded MCP tool-use guidance; first-class form conversion from Kobo, ODK, CommCare, and Qualtrics; form-label translation support; XLSForm template sanitization; instance_name support.
1.0.0-beta.3: network-egress reliability fix for MCP calls, plus agent-visible versioning so the server can announce skill updates.
